marketLayer.title: US Fed Policy Expectation & Megacap Tech Volatility
marketLayer.fact: U.S. inflation data signaled persistent core pressure, leading Treasury yields to rise slightly and causing mixed performance across major U.S. technology leaders ahead of key earnings.
marketLayer.inference: High interest rates continue to constrain valuation multiples for long-duration growth equities, encouraging defensive positioning toward cash-rich Big Tech balance sheets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Upcoming Federal Reserve rate decisions and forward guidance on monetary policy timeline.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Tech Index & Southbound Capital Inflows
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index rallied during Asian trading hours, supported by net Southbound capital inflows exceeding HK$4 billion via the Stock Connect program.
marketLayer.inference: Institutional investors are rotating into undervalued Chinese internet and software leaders amid ongoing fiscal policy support and stabilized earnings expectations.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of domestic consumption recovery and broader macroeconomic momentum in Mainland China.

marketLayer.title: China New Energy Vehicle (NEV) Delivery Trends
marketLayer.fact: HK-listed Chinese EV manufacturers reported strong mid-year vehicle delivery growth figures alongside continued price promotions across flagship models.
marketLayer.inference: Volume growth remains robust for market leaders, but gross margins may face headwinds if promotional discounting persists into late Q3.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving export tariffs in overseas markets and local market share dynamics.
